        je viens            I come            nous venons          we come
        tu viens        you come         vous venez             you come
         il/elle vient      he/she comes         ils/elles viennent         they come

questions.prompt: Il (faire) __ des grimaces devant le miroir.The causative form The causative form is, in most cases, used to express the idea of having something done by someone or of causing something to happen. It is formed with the verb faire followed by an infinitive. Elle écrit la lettre elle-même. She writes the letter herself. Elle fait écrire la lettre par sa She has the letter written by her secrétaire. secretary. Ils envoient le document. They send the document. Ils font envoyer le document. They have the document sent. Elle fait la robe. She is making the dress. Elle fait faire la robe. She is having the dress made.
questions.source_raw_prompt:
Il (faire) ________________ des grimaces devant le miroir.The causative form
The causative form is, in most cases, used to express the idea of having something
done by someone or of causing something to happen. It is formed with the verb faire
followed by an infinitive.

       Elle écrit la lettre elle-même.         She writes the letter herself.
       Elle fait écrire la lettre par sa        She has the letter written by her
           secrétaire.                              secretary.
         Ils envoient le document.            They send the document.
         Ils font envoyer le document.        They have the document sent.
       Elle fait la robe.                   She is making the dress.
       Elle fait faire la robe.               She is having the dress made.
